fact_previews: Montreal Music Labs created the Articulations controller touchscreen app for virtual instruments.
The Articulations app allows users to access all their articulations and key switches from one simple interface.
Montreal Music Labs is based in Montreal, Canada.
The funding for the Articulations project was canceled by the project creator on December 20, 2019.
The funding period for the Articulations project was from November 20, 2019, to December 20, 2019.

fact_previews: Montreal Music Labs creates technical products for creative people.
Montreal Music Labs aims to simplify how people make music on computers.
Montreal Music Labs has released VM1, an iPad controller application for VSL's Vienna Ensemble Pro 7.
Montreal Music Labs is developing the Articulate App.
Articulate is an integrated AU/VST/AAX plugin and touchscreen app solution.

fact_previews: Articulate is a solution that gives Music Composers quick control with minimal user configuration.
Articulate allows all instrument articulations to appear on the iPad as simple buttons.
Selecting a desired articulation in Articulate stores it as automation in the DAW, not MIDI.
Articulate enables easier editing and standard automation functions such as touch, latch, and overwrite.
A post-release update will allow control of the most relevant parameters of the plugin directly from Articulate.
